questions.q: What did Milica do instead of sleeping?
questions.e: In the video: "umesto da odspavam, uzela bih telefon i gledala društvene mreže" — instead of getting some sleep, I would pick up my phone and watch social media.

questions.q: Who is Ivana?
o: A medical student and a mom
questions.e: In the video: "Ona je studentkinja Medicinskog fakulteta u Beogradu i mama trogodišnje Krune." — she is a student at the Faculty of Medicine in Belgrade and the mother of three-year-old Kruna.

questions.q: How old was Kruna when Ivana left her with her mother?
questions.e: In the video: "Kruna je u tom trenutku imala samo tri meseca" — Kruna was only three months old at the time.

questions.q: What was Kruna's dad until recently?
questions.e: In the video: "Krunin tata je doskoro bio student. I to ni manje ni više nego pravnog fakulteta." — Kruna's dad was a student until recently, and no less than at the law faculty.

questions.q: What does Katarina do besides studying?
o: Deputy editor of a youth newsroom
questions.e: In the video: "Katarina nije samo mama studentkinja, već i zamenica urednika omladinske redakcije Pressing iz Niša." — Katarina is not only a student mom but also the deputy editor of the youth newsroom Pressing.

questions.q: What does "freezing the status" of a student mean?
questions.e: In the video: "svaka studentkinja koja ostane trudna tokom studija ima pravo da zamrzne svoje studije" — every student who gets pregnant during her studies has the right to freeze her studies.

questions.q: How long does maternity leave count after the birth?
questions.e: In the video: "porodiljskog odsustva koje se računa godinu dana od porođaja" — maternity leave, which counts as a year after the birth.

questions.q: Why does Ivana keep filming for TikTok?
o: To be an example for girls
questions.e: In the video: "Ja sam stvarno samo tu da budem neki primer devojkama" — I'm really only here to be an example to girls.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Hvala ti na *čestitkama*.
questions.e: čestitka — congratulation; dat. pl.

questions.q: Gradivo je *ogromno*
questions.e: ogroman — enormous; neut.

questions.q: Imala sam mnogo ispita koje sam morala da *položim*
questions.e: položiti ispit — to pass an exam

questions.q: morao je da *sprema* ispite
questions.e: spremati ispit — to prepare for an exam

questions.q: Najviše vremena mi je *oduzimao* TikTok
questions.e: oduzimati — to take away

questions.q: ja nemam nikakav *izgovor*
questions.e: izgovor — excuse (also: pronunciation)

questions.q: Heroinama koje se svakodnevno *bore* za bolju budućnost
questions.e: boriti se — to fight, to struggle

questions.q: Zato sam i odlučila da pitam svoje *sagovornice*
questions.e: sagovornica — interlocutor (f.)

questions.q: Hvala ti ___ čestitkama.
questions.e: Hvala na + loc.: hvala na čestitkama — thanks for the congratulations.

questions.q: Ona je studentkinja novinarstva na ___ fakultetu u Nišu.
questions.e: After na (where?) the locative is used: na Filozofskom fakultetu.

questions.q: Tada bih, konačno, ___ telefon i zamenila ga knjigom.
questions.e: A single completed action takes the perfective: ostavila (fem. past with bih).

questions.q: Saznanje da je ___ u drugom stanju Ivanu je ispunilo emocijama.
questions.e: The subject is female, so the past tense ends in -la: ostala.

questions.q: Ivana je Krunu često morala da ostavlja kod svoje ___
questions.e: Kod + gen.: kod svoje mame — at her mom's.

questions.q: Bez ___ bi verovatno ispunjavanje svih njihovih dnevnih obaveza bilo znatno teže
questions.e: Bez + gen.: bez nje — without her.

questions.q: Katarina se vratila svom ___ poslu
questions.e: Svom poslu is dative; the adjective agrees: prethodnom.

questions.q: Mnogo je izazova u ___ studiranju i roditeljstvu.
questions.e: U + loc. neut.: u istovremenom studiranju.
